2 أبّد , inf. n. تَأْبِيدٌ, He made, or rendered, perpetual. (S, K.) [See also the pass. part. n. below.] لَمْ أَفْعَلْ تَأْبِيدًا is a phrase used as though meaning ↓ لَمْ آتِ بِآبِدَةٍ [I did not a deed ever to be remembered, or mentioned]. (Ham p. 191.) ―
-b2- He, or it, made [a beast] to take fright; to become wild, or sky. (KL.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
